name: ContractIntakeOrchestrator
trigger: When file created in SharePoint (Contracts library)
actions: Scope_Try: Classify via Foundry contract_classifier (HTTP + Entra token from Key Vault)
Scope_Catch: If 429/5xx → Delay exponential backoff (Do Until 3x) → log to Dataverse exception table
Condition: confidence >0.92 → auto → SAP connector else → Create Approval (Teams Adaptive Card) + Dataverse audit
Finally: Track custom event to App Insights
